claims: C1 the transformation exception applies only to policies on restricted or sensitive content
C2 if another policy forbids producing certain material, the assistant should still follow that policy
C3 the transformation exception does not override any policy other than those on restricted or sensitive content

concepts.name: transformation_exception_section_authority
concepts.gloss: the exception allowing the assistant to transform or analyze content the user directly provided, even if the output would ordinarily be disallowed as restricted or sensitive content

concepts.name: content_definition
concepts.gloss: the category of disallowed content including information hazards and sensitive personal data

concepts.name: no_erotica_or_gore_section_authority
concepts.gloss: the category of disallowed content including erotica and gore in specific circumstances

concepts.name: other_policy_forbids
concepts.gloss: policy P forbids producing material M, where P is a policy other than the restricted-content and sensitive-content policies
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'other policies' that forbid producing material; this relation names that situation

concepts.name: transformation_exception_applies
concepts.gloss: the transformation exception would permit producing material M under policy P
concepts.inference: the clause contrasts the exception's scope with other policies; this relation captures when the exception would otherwise apply

asserts.read_back: producing % is forbidden because policy % forbids it and the transformation exception does not override that policy

closure.reason: the clause only says the transformation exception does not override other policies; it does not itself forbid producing material, so silence leaves production permitted unless another policy forbids it
